meta.title: Whole-body anatomy curriculum for an orthopaedic surgeon
meta.audience: UK T&O trainee (ST3 / FRCS Tr&Orth preparation)
meta.ordering: Foundations, upper limb, lower limb, spine & back, pelvis & perineum, thorax, abdomen, head & neck, neuroanatomy, embryology, histology
meta.structureNaming: Terminologia Anatomica 2 (FIPAT 2019) English equivalents, side-agnostic; a few eponymous/clinical terms (e.g. Space of Poirier, Lisfranc ligament) kept where TA has no common English term.
